title: Yukawa CIELingo Coupler Y_{NOEMA}
description: Yukawa-style coupling between ERB geometry and CIELingo inference depth. Y_{NOEMA} gates CIELingo inference latency by local geometric coherence: inference_depth[i] ∝ R_geom[i] where R_geom[i] = |Z_i| = |(1/N) Σ_j g_{ij} e^{iφ_j}| is the local Kuramoto order parameter weighted by the ERB metric. High local coherence (R → 1) enables deep inference; low coherence (R → 0) forces shallow fallback. Named after the Yukawa coupling in particle physics where interaction strength is mediated by a scalar field — here the scalar order parameter R_geom mediates CIELingo processing depth.
